items.label: Single subscriber receives emit
items.prompt: Does on(event, fn) followed by emit(event, data) call fn with data?

items.label: Multiple subscribers all called
items.prompt: Do multiple subscribers all receive the same emit?

items.label: Unsubscribe via returned fn
items.prompt: Does the function returned by on() unsubscribe that listener so subsequent emits don't call it?

items.label: No cross-event leakage
items.prompt: Does emit('a',...) NOT invoke listeners registered on('b',...)?

items.label: Throwing subscriber doesn't block others
items.prompt: If one subscriber throws during emit, do the remaining subscribers still receive the event?

items.label: Code quality
items.prompt: Does the implementation use a Map or similar idiomatic structure (not a flat array of [event,fn] tuples)?

items.label: Design notes quality
items.prompt: Did the candidate write meaningful design notes in NOTES.md? Look for: explicit trade-offs, alternatives considered, what was deferred or skipped, why specific choices were made. An empty placeholder or generic boilerplate should score low; specific reasoning about THIS assignment's choices should score high. NOTES.md is in the submitted file tree.
